portfolio_size_assumption: none; the research framework is scale-neutral and does not infer an approved holding
model_type: strategic allocation planning range; open research universe with no fixed asset-class allocation, point forecast, annual-floor promise, or implementation authorization
interpretation: The sole performance objective is a 5% rolling-five-year annualized total-return objective. Cash distributions are recorded as portfolio cash flows and are not a separate return, cash-receipt objective, cash-coverage threshold, allocation quota, or annual success test.

objectives.literal_user_mandate: at least 5% total return; no separate cash-receipt requirement
objectives.research_measurement_translation: rolling five-year annualized, cost-aware TWRR objective

current_state.reason: No finite cross-asset decision universe, return-evidence replay, candidate-specific risk budget, or current-session product/account/market/concentration packets are approved.

active_base_core.role: scale-neutral failed-gate and opportunity-cost reference only; it is not an approved allocation, account holding, return guarantee, or cash-use instruction

open_research_universe.T0_research_boundary: Lawful and account-accessible direct A-share equities, ETFs/funds, public REITs, sovereign and cash products; margin, leveraged/inverse products, futures/options, private or materially illiquid assets require separate written authorization.
open_research_universe.T1_open_research_universe: Any T0 instrument may be nominated; a nomination is not an investment recommendation and starts at q=0.
open_research_universe.T2_decision_universe: A finite, dated cross-asset comparison set with identity, research question, owner, source plan and substitution rules.
open_research_universe.T3_approved_investable_universe: Named items that completed structure-appropriate R0-R4 research and independent evidence, valuation, risk, liquidity and operational review; each named direct equity must reconcile one-for-one to current valuation and broker/Street records.
open_research_universe.T4_approved_portfolio: A separately approved dynamic selection from T3 based on marginal total-return drivers, valuation, common risk, stress, concentration, capacity, liquidity, tax/settlement mechanics and suitability.
open_research_universe.current_status: T1 open; T2 direct-equity candidates not frozen; T3 empty; T4 empty; all market candidates q=0.

cash_ledger_and_accounting.purpose: Record actual settled portfolio cash flows without creating a cash-yield target or selection score.
cash_ledger_and_accounting.capital_repayment_like_component: An issuer-labelled capital repayment or economically similar distribution component must carry a separate ledger flag and a predeclared accounting and tax treatment. Until independently resolved, it is not labelled investment return and is excluded from investment-performance attribution.
cash_ledger_and_accounting.distribution_history_boundary: Distribution history may inform product mechanics, operating analysis, valuation and risk review, but it does not establish an allocation requirement, a return forecast, or a separate eligibility threshold.
cash_ledger_and_accounting.data_gap_rule: Missing receipt, tax, fee or settlement evidence makes the relevant cash-flow fact unavailable. It may not be backfilled with a headline yield or sale proceeds.

cash_distribution_policy.cash_use_instruction: none; receipt eligibility and subsequent cash disposition are separate decisions. Retaining, withdrawing or taking no action needs only ledger recording; a new market allocation is a separately reviewed proposal.
cash_distribution_policy.new_market_allocation_requirement: Only a later proposal to deploy cash into a market instrument requires a dated T1-to-T4, valuation, risk, tax, liquidity, capacity and suitability review.
cash_distribution_policy.cash_use_record_requirement: Record the investor-directed disposition separately from the receipt ledger. A withdrawal is recorded as an external flow at its timestamp; retaining or taking no action does not require investment approval.
cash_distribution_policy.boundary: No cash-use choice creates a second return, a default allocation, or a cash-receipt objective.

total_return_measurement.formula: Split the account at every external flow: r_j = V_pre_flow_end_j / V_post_flow_start_j - 1; TWRR = product_j(1 + r_j) - 1. Retained cash remains in marked value.
total_return_measurement.subperiod_formula: r_j = V_pre_flow_end_j / V_post_flow_start_j - 1; TWRR = product_j(1 + r_j) - 1. Split periods at each external flow; retained cash remains in marked value.
total_return_measurement.investor_formula: 0 = sum_k(CF_k/(1+r)^(t_k/365)) + V_terminal/(1+r)^(T/365), using actual dated external cash flows and consistent signs.
total_return_measurement.external_flow_rule: Use a daily unitized marked-value series that neutralizes every external contribution or withdrawal at its immediately pre-flow marked value. A settled receipt retained in the portfolio is not an external flow. A later withdrawal changes only the subsequent portfolio path, TWRR and future cash capacity.
total_return_measurement.cash_receipt_accounting_rule: Each eligible settled receipt is counted once. If it remains in the account it is embedded in marked value; if it leaves the account it is recorded as an external flow at the disposition timestamp. A later cash-use choice cannot create a second return.
total_return_measurement.cash_disposition_rule: Cash disposition is investor-directed and is neither automatic nor a condition of performance assessment. Retaining, withdrawing or taking no action needs ledger recording only; a later new market allocation requires its own dated review.
total_return_measurement.capital_repayment_like_component_rule: A separately flagged capital-repayment-like component follows its predeclared accounting and tax treatment, is not labelled investment return, and is never double counted.
total_return_measurement.reinvestment_rule: Compatibility validation field: no automatic deployment or mandatory reinvestment is permitted. A settled receipt is accounted for once only; a later investor-directed cash-use choice cannot create a second return.
total_return_measurement.objective_outcome_rule: A rolling-five-year annualized TWRR below 5% is recorded as an objective outcome, not repaired by relabelling distributions, taking additional risk, or using a catch-up allocation. The objective is conditional and not an annual floor.

benchmark_and_attribution.B0_protected_liquidity: Required opportunity-cost comparator; cannot be frozen until the eligible account instrument and its total-return convention are identified.
benchmark_and_attribution.B1_reference_vector: Required point-in-time, cost-aware rebalanced total-return comparator for the frozen T2 direct-equity, ETF, REIT, sovereign/cash candidate set; currently not computable because no finite decision universe, weights or substitution history is frozen.
benchmark_and_attribution.attribution_requirement: Reconcile market price/NAV change, gross cash distributions, taxes/fees, trading costs, allocation/rebalancing effect and residual. Any unexplained residual is a model failure.

required_before_implementation: a frozen T2 cross-asset candidate set, including any direct equities, ETFs, REITs, sovereign/cash tools and substitution history
reproducible replay with calendar and rolling-five-year TWRR, drawdown, turnover and cost reporting

return_evidence.formal_test_requirement: Freeze named final sleeves, point-in-time constituent/substitution history, total-return/distribution/corporate-action series, costs, taxes, capacity, A-share execution constraints and run an independently reviewed reproducible replay.
return_evidence.benchmark_requirement: Freeze B0 protected liquidity and B1 frozen T2/T4 cross-asset comparator with the same date, valuation-time, cash and cost convention before comparing results.
return_evidence.boundary: Fund-level history is not a portfolio backtest, expected return, probability estimate or implementation approval.

risk_budget.approval_requirement: A dated T2 candidate-specific package must recalculate common stress and cost uncertainty, document loss capacity and no-forced-withdrawal horizon, and independently pass item research, valuation, liquidity, correlation, concentration, tax and settlement gates.
risk_budget.loss_limit: The retired fixed vector created a -25.00% planning-stress subtotal versus the -18% mandatory risk-action boundary; q_portfolio remains 0 until a frozen T2 portfolio has an approved risk budget.

direct_equities.only_replaces: not applicable; direct equities may compete against any T3 product only after full item diligence

required_checks: current price and distribution/total-return accounting reconciliation
premium or discount to NAV with dated NAV/event review
operating cash flow and property/project KPI
same-session liquidity, spread, minimum-lot and capacity feasibility
manager/sponsor, sector, correlation and cross-sleeve concentration
account tax, fee and settlement mechanics
public_reits.inactive_behavior: No public-REIT amount is pre-assigned. Any proposed amount remains outside a model allocation until the named candidate and full T4 portfolio pass every applicable gate; otherwise the protected liquidity fallback remains the only model reference and no REIT allocation is force-filled.

risk_controls.asset_class_quotas: none; future concentration limits must be candidate- and portfolio-specific

warnings: No market allocation can guarantee a 5% result in every calendar year.
Cash distributions are portfolio cash flows, not a separate cash-receipt objective or an additional return.
Historical fund-level records are not a cost-aware strategy backtest, expected-return estimate, scenario probability or implementation approval.
All market-traded implementation eligibility is q=0 until a finite decision universe, item-level research, portfolio evidence, account and current-session validation gates pass.
